name: btc_chronology_stability_reconstruction_20261027
purpose: Decompose E0038 conditional economics by entry month and concentration.
Reconstruct earlier-only A/B/C/D folds inside development without using holdout.
Measure the existing full offline feature-to-prediction path without network or trading effects.

strategy_invariants.cohort: Only the frozen E0038 source-quality-clean development whitelist for economics.
strategy_invariants.minimum_order: D0019 verified-USDC rule; frozen $5 fallback; reject below minimum without rounding.
strategy_invariants.fees_and_accounting: Reuse E0038/D0006 semantics; lock gross cost through payout availability; no credit/deposits; cost-basis equity drawdown, not mark-to-market.

label_and_selection_rules.proxy_target: Close[Opened+6m] >= Open[Opened+2m], ties UP; label available at Opened+7m.
label_and_selection_rules.training_label_rule: Only finite labels with label_available_at < the fold's exclusive fit cutoff; purge is by timestamp, not row count.
label_and_selection_rules.internal_selection: Generator search, target weights, feature selection, model hyperparameters/iterations, and official calibration must use chronological inner data with label availability before the outer fit cutoff.
label_and_selection_rules.official_calibration: Daily expanding official Gamma Platt from out-of-sample predictions only; outcome release max(resolved_at, market_start+5m)+60s; minimum 1,000 prior outcomes and both classes, preserving the existing rule.
label_and_selection_rules.candidate_family_history: A=BASE70; B=BASE70+simple-memory PCA8; C=BASE70+ESN PCA8; D=BASE70+memory+ESN. Preserve the previously exposed family/seed history; a successful local chronology run is not independent confirmation of that search history.

existing_procedure_budgets.first_run_order: Complete F1 end-to-end and measure its actual runtime before F2 and F3; do not change the recipe based on F1 PnL.

transform_policy.memory: Reuse only the saved scaler/PCA verified fit-core-only through 2024-07-01; rebuild causal memory state from every raw minute, including minutes without an executable market; reset on invalid input or any non-one-minute timestamp gap.
transform_policy.esn: Reuse only the saved scaler/PCA and ESN config whose transform fit is through 2024-07-01 and whose candidate choice ends 2025-07-01; continue state chronologically over every minute; preserve the three frozen reservoir seeds.
transform_policy.feature_selection: Refit the 64 non-flow BASE70 features independently before each outer test window; append the six locally materialized causal taker_Z/V features. Do not reuse the full-development selected list.
transform_policy.model: Refit each A/B/C/D LightGBM member before its outer window; refit weights/hyperparameters/iterations inside the preceding development only; retain frozen seed identities and uniform ensemble weights. Record any fold-specific feature-order/config changes.

accounting_protocol.portfolio_path: One uninterrupted $100 path across F1, F2, F3 for each model/control/delay; never reset at month or fold boundary.
accounting_protocol.entry: Frozen T-60/T-59 rule and E0038 clean source snapshots only; no PMXT replay.
accounting_protocol.unavailable_markets: Remain unknown; do not convert missing calendar coverage into no_trade.

offline_runtime_sample.selection: Sort the E0038 clean development cohort by market_start_utc and condition_id; select 100 evenly spaced indices in each of April, May, and June, including each month's first and last available row. No PnL or prediction value enters selection.
timed_sections: causal input and memory/ESN state update

resume_plan.identity: Hash frozen config, exact prefix/allowlist/source hashes, candidate transforms, and runner/source code before reading fold labels.
checkpoint_order: F1 target weights and feature selection
F1 inner model selection and official OOF calibration
resume_plan.resume: Reuse only complete, identity-matching, output-hash-verified stage checkpoints; otherwise stop on identity change and issue a new protocol version.

pre_fit_gate.reason: No single offline orchestrator currently composes fold-local BASE70 generator/feature selection, the six causal taker_Z/V inputs, A/B/C/D memory/ESN variants, and earlier-only official-Gamma OOF Platt calibration. run_btc_preopen_experiment.py emits one model and Binance-proxy calibration; the saved full-development selected 64-feature list and weights are post-test for these folds. Running it unchanged or substituting those saved choices would violate this freeze.
pre_fit_gate.runtime_gate_reason: The available candidate model bundles lack an offline streaming adapter for the exact selected BASE70 64 generated features plus taker_Z/V. Batch feature generation or a ready future-cache vector cannot be reported as the full per-decision hot path.
pre_fit_gate.available_resources: 14 physical / 20 logical Intel i7-13650HX cores, 64 GiB RAM, RTX 4060 Laptop GPU, about 151 GB free on D: at freeze; no heavy competing training process observed.
pre_fit_gate.not_a_blocker: Missing historical prediction_available_at timestamps are not required for the explicitly labeled simulated chronology; no current source-acquisition, T0010, holdout, pilot, or DNS step is allowed.
